_: plan-11324 S3a BC-S3 (a3 #58597, a4 #58598): the CLASS of every environment name an org process may carry. When the host runs several orgs (orgs.multi), spawn's pane and every generated unit start from an EMPTY environment (env -i) and keep only the PASS classes (host, pane) from what they inherited, then set the home class from the org's HOME. org names (the ones an org's .env holds: derived from the code and from the HOME's .env at use time, never typed here) and session names and seam names (a mutation probe's *_SRC: a mutant copy standing in for a subject) and harness names (what devtools/check.sh exports for its gates: a test role stamp, the sqlguard shim's PYTHONPATH) are DROPPED, and so is any name in no class. An unclassed name in a process that runs the gate fails it (tests/test_org_home_census.py), so a new name is accused, never silently passed. Patterns are fnmatch globs.
